question: why is women in mathematics day celebrated on may 12
answer: May 12 commemorates the birth date of Professor Maryam Mirzakhani, the first woman and first Iranian to win the Fields Medal (2014), and the only woman to have won it since 1936.
evidence: May 12 was chosen to commemorate the birth date of Professor Maryam Mirzakhani , the first woman and first Iranian to win the Fields Medal in 2014
